title: Exiting the demo ("Exit demo") fires the demo_reset PostHog event, conflating exit with reset
detail: The shell's "Exit demo" button (chunk hunk in shell.gleam) dispatches UserClickedLogout, which records demo_reset — the same event the "Reset demo" button fires. The briefing's analytics pillar ("capturing entry, key surfaces, downloads, CTA clicks") is meant to show which surfaces sell; exits now inflate the reset count.
recommended_fix: Fire a distinct demo_exit event (or no event) from the UserClickedLogout demo branch; keep demo_reset exclusively for the banner reset button.

title: Policy-version conformance check compares two hardcoded literals, so a shared/policy_highlights bump wouldn't fail the drift guard
detail: The fixture (demo_fixtures.gleam:26) and this assertion both hardcode "2026-05-23"; neither references shared/policy_highlights.version ("2026-05-23" today). A policy bump leaves this test green while the fixture goes stale — the comment's claimed guard is vacuous. Runtime impact is nil (demo never populates server_policy_version, so the modal can't fire), but the drift-guard claim oversells.
recommended_fix: Assert landlord.accepted_policy_version |> should.equal(policy_highlights.version) so a version bump fails the conformance suite; fix the comment to match the actual runtime mechanism.
